findings.title: GET /books/{id}: sends 404 instead of 400 for non-integer path id
findings.detail: Spec requires 400 for 'an id in the path that is not an integer'. Code does int(path.split('/')[-1]) and on ValueError sends 404.

findings.title: DELETE /books/{id}: sends 404 instead of 400 for non-integer path id
findings.detail: Spec requires 400 for 'an id in the path that is not an integer'. Code does int(path.split('/')[-1]) and on ValueError sends 404.

findings.title: Missing field type validation in POST and PUT (do_POST, do_PUT)
findings.detail: Spec requires 400 for a field of the wrong type. Code never checks that title/author/isbn are strings and synopsis is string/optional.

findings.title: POST do_POST crashes with AttributeError when required field missing
findings.detail: Code checks 'not title.strip()' which raises AttributeError for None (missing key) instead of sending 400 for missing required field.

findings.title: PUT do_PUT lacks type validation and empty required field validation
findings.detail: Spec says PUT has 'same rules as create'. Code doesn't check types or empty required fields like create does.

findings.title: Empty-body POST sends 400 before JSON parsing (redundant)
findings.detail: Explicit empty-content_length check sends 400 before json.loads. Redundant with JSONDecodeError handling.

findings.title: Redundant error messages in POST (isbn checked twice)
findings.detail: isbn=='' check and broader empty check produce two different error messages.
